cerulean-sky.$description: Cerulean Sky — Full-bleed canvas for hero and atmospheric sections, primary nav background, sky-illustration base

deep-cerulean.$description: Deep Cerulean — Tinted shadow color — the brand-blue cast on every elevation shadow makes even drop shadows feel atmospheric

atmosphere-blue.$description: Atmosphere Blue — Outlined action border — secondary buttons and card outlines gain a cool sky tint instead of neutral gray

midnight-navy.$description: Midnight Navy — Primary filled action background — the Get Started pill, pressed against the sky, reads as a deep horizon line

berry-red.$description: Berry Red — Single chromatic accent — reserved for emphasis ink, important markers, and the occasional stamp of urgency against the blue

cloud-white.$description: Cloud White — Primary surface for cards, product UI, testimonial panels — the white that floats against the sky

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Subtle card background for nested surfaces, the lightest gray still distinct from pure white

fog.$description: Fog — Hairline borders and dividers — the only neutral border color in the system

stone.$description: Stone — Muted helper text and secondary metadata

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text, icon fills, low-emphasis labels

ink.$description: Ink — Body text and dominant UI strokes — the dark that anchors serif type against white cards

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Deepest text tone, used sparingly for highest-emphasis body copy with a barely-warm purple undertone

switzer.$description: Product and UI workhorse — body copy at 16-18px weight 400, navigation and buttons at 14-16px weight 500-600, labels at 12-14px weight 500. This geometric grotesque (Indian Type Foundry) stays out of the serif's way; the pair of a literary display face and a neutral UI face is the system's tonal balance.

signifier.$description: Display and headline serif — light weight (300) at 45-55px for hero and section titles, regular (400) at 24-36px for subheadings. The italic-leaning, high-contrast serif (Indian Type Foundry family) is the brand's literary voice; weight 300 makes headlines feel aspirational rather than commanding.

times.$description: Times — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
